text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Pushing past formidable rivals, Cheval 
Grand achieved a splendid victory in the 
Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, comparing herself to rivals 
holding strong and Duramente, who had her 
sights set on becoming the "strongest," 
Cheval Grand couldn't quite find her 
confidence.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hoping to one day see her puff out her 
chest and say, "I was amazing!", I left 
the racecourse behind.
